wordmark.purpose: GRIDMASTER on the start screen, extruded with a lip.

number.purpose: Score, level, timer, coins. Always tabular figures.

shadows.name: lip-regular
shadows.purpose: Solid lower edge of keys, tiles and panels; 2px while pressed, face travels 4px.

shadows.name: lip-small
shadows.purpose: Pills, badges, icon keys, empty tiles; 1.5px while pressed.

shadows.name: soft-drop
shadows.purpose: Only under large keys and panels, never under grid tiles.

shadows.name: halo
shadows.purpose: Blur-free glow for glow_grid, neon_border_grid and the pulse/sparkle animations.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Tile placed, pattern entrance, cue text.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Pattern entrance and the diagonal level-up wave.

motion.name: particles
motion.purpose: Burst in the tile color on placement and in the wave.

motion.name: wiggle
motion.purpose: Wrong tiles when the solution shows.

motion.name: shake
motion.purpose: Play area on failure, never the banner.

motion.name: level-up-window
motion.purpose: Time between a solved level and the next preview.

components.name: CTA Key
components.description: Yellow key for the main action: play, skip, watch ad, prices.
components.css: .ds-key-cta { font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; color: #4A3506; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, #FFC83D 90%, white) 0%, #FFC83D 45%, color-mix(in srgb, #FFC83D 82%, #C9901A) 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #C9901A; transform: translateY(0); transition: transform 90ms ease-out, box-shadow 90ms ease-out; } .ds-key-cta:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #C9901A; } .ds-key-cta:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F4F5FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Key
components.description: Green key for continue and retry.
components.css: .ds-key-primary { font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; color: #0B3323; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, #2CCB8C 90%, white) 0%, #2CCB8C 45%, color-mix(in srgb, #2CCB8C 82%, #1C9063) 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #1C9063; transform: translateY(0); transition: transform 90ms ease-out, box-shadow 90ms ease-out; } .ds-key-primary:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #1C9063; } .ds-key-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F4F5FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Neutral Key
components.description: Secondary actions on panels; its lip is darker than the panel.
components.css: .ds-key-raised { font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, #3D4379 90%, white) 0%, #3D4379 45%, color-mix(in srgb, #3D4379 82%, #191D3C) 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #191D3C; transform: translateY(0); transition: transform 90ms ease-out, box-shadow 90ms ease-out; font-size: 16px; } .ds-key-raised:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #191D3C; } .ds-key-raised:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F4F5FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Board
components.description: Sunken tray with colored tiles and empty wells.
components.css: .ds-tray { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 56px); gap: 8px; padding: 10px 10px 16px; border-radius: 22px; width: max-content; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0A0D1A 0%, #101327 12%, #151830 100%); } .ds-tile { display: block; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 12px; transition: transform 90ms ease-out, box-shadow 90ms ease-out; } .ds-tile-empty { background: #2A2F57; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #1D2142; } .ds-tile-blue { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4FAEF6, #3BA3F5 45%, #3798E6); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #2372B5; } .ds-tile-red { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FF7A6E, #FF6B5E 45%, #F46255); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #C4463B; } .ds-tile-green { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #41D098, #2CCB8C 45%, #29C085); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #1C9063; } .ds-tile:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #1D2142; }

components.name: Tab Keys
components.description: Shop tabs as a row of keys; the chosen one stays pushed in.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tab { font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; color: #fff; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: #3D4379; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #191D3C; transition: transform 90ms ease-out, box-shadow 90ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:active, .ds-tab-on { transform: translateY(2.5px); box-shadow: 0 1.5px 0 #191D3C; } .ds-tab-on { background: #2CCB8C; color: #0B3323; box-shadow: 0 1.5px 0 #1C9063; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F4F5FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Coin Pill
components.description: Coin balance; counts up and bumps when it changes.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #FFC83D; padding: 5px 14px 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #2A2F57; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #11142B; } .ds-coin { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #FFE27A, #F5A800); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #C47F00; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Overlay card, shop rows, settings cards. Stat wells inside are sunken, never nested panels.
components.css: .ds-panel { font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; color: #F4F5FF; width: 240px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 28px; text-align: center; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3F4468 0%, #2A2F57 45%, #262B50 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #11142B, 0 12px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); } .ds-panel-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 32px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-stat { border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0A0D1A 0%, #101327 12%, #151830 100%); } .ds-stat small { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.2px; color: #969DCB; } .ds-stat b { font-size: 24px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #5FE0B0; }

narrative.northStar: A box of chunky plastic tiles you press with your thumb
narrative.overview: Gridmaster is a memory puzzle played in short sessions, one-handed. Every surface is a physical piece: a face sitting on a solid darker lip. Pressing sinks the face 4 px and the lip shrinks from 6 to 2; the outer size never changes. The board is a sunken tray, the palette a row of keys within thumb reach. Depth comes from the lip, one soft drop shadow under large pieces, and a faint top-lit gradient. One shared look on iOS and Android; eight cosmetic themes swap the colors and get computed lips.
keyCharacteristics: Face plus solid lip on every interactive piece
Sunken wells for the board, stat tiles and tracks
Overshoot pop and pooled particle bursts in the tile color
Pattern colors are reserved for the pattern

rules.name: The Lip Rule
rules.body: A lip is always darker than the ground its piece sits on. Panels on the background use #11142B, keys on panels #191D3C; themes compute theirs.

rules.name: The Pattern Color Rule
rules.body: Tile colors are never dimmed and never reused for controls that are not pattern colors; the hint key is neutral for that reason.

rules.name: The Banner Lane Rule
rules.body: Nothing animates at, on or over an ad banner. Particles and the screen shake are clipped to the play area, overlays stop above a loaded banner.

rules.name: The Cheap Phone Rule
rules.body: No blur per tile. Halos are stacked translucent outlines, particles live in one pooled painter, board and particles sit in their own repaint boundaries.

dos: Do build new controls from TactileSurface, TactileButton, TactileCell and TactileWell.
Do read every color from ThemeProvider.palette so purchased themes apply everywhere.
Do respect MediaQuery.disableAnimations: keep the press, drop cascades, hops, shakes and particles.
Do make paid grid styles and cell animations add on top of the default effects.
donts: Don't use hairline borders, translucent panels or Material ripples.
Don't change a piece's outer size on press.
Don't switch to Cupertino or Material idioms per platform.
Don't put a soft shadow or blur under grid tiles.
